changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_tag ( user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, tag_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_user_tag PRIMARY KEY (user_id, tag_id), CONSTRAINT fk_user_tag_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_user_tag_tag FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_user_tag_user ON user_tag (user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_user_tag_tag ON user_tag (tag_id);
